english.notes:
(i) See Section 21(7) for place where offence deemed to have been committed for jurisdiction purposes.
(ii) See offence wording H4541 and Section 14 for offence type(s) which attract an either way penalty, details of which are given at Section 21(4). These offences are given by offence wordings H4530, H4531, H4532, H4533, H4534, H4535 and H4536 inclusive.
(iii) The Home Office code to be attached to this offence is that attached to the substantive offence.
